# Finobots

> An open-source AI financial operations agent for small businesses.

Finobots connects to PayPal and lets you manage balances, transactions, reconciliation and cash flow, with a chat assistant that proposes actions such as sending an invoice or a payment reminder. Nothing runs until you approve it.

## Product

- Live: https://finobots.vercel.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/opsenes-ai/finobots
- Issues: https://github.com/opsenes-ai/finobots/issues/new
- Discussions: https://github.com/opsenes-ai/finobots/discussions

## Features

- Chat with streamed replies, saved history and Recents
- Built-in Claude Haiku 5.5, or your own Claude, OpenAI or Gemini key
- Reply tone, length, custom instructions and memories
- Approval cards for proposed PayPal actions (send invoice, send reminder)
- Credits for the built-in model (100 credits, 5 added daily) and daily, weekly and monthly USD spending limits
- PayPal connections: balance sync, transaction import, payment webhooks
- Accounts: balances per currency and manual accounts
- Transactions: AG Grid ledger, filters, categories, reconciliation and receipts
- Cash flow: money in and out, monthly trends, spending by category, 30-day forecast
- Settings: profile, personalization, usage, data export, two-factor, notifications, API keys

## Integrations

- PayPal (sandbox and live)
- Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini

## Tech stack

- Framework: Next.js 16 (App Router)
- Language: TypeScript
- UI: React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui (base-nova), Base UI, Lucide React
- Grid: AG Grid Community
- Backend: Supabase (Auth, Postgres with row level security, Storage, Edge Functions)
- Deployment: Vercel

## Routes

- / — Home
- /auth/login — Log in
- /auth/signup — Sign up
- /auth/forgot — Forgot password
- /auth/reset — Reset password
- /legal/terms — Terms of Service
- /legal/privacy — Privacy Policy
- /legal/cookies — Cookie Policy
- /console — Redirects to /console/chat
- /console/chat — New chat
- /console/chat/[chatId] — Chat session
- /console/recents — Previous chats
- /console/accounts — Accounts
- /console/transaction — Transactions
- /console/cashflow — Cash flow
- /console/connections — Connections
- /console/settings/profile — Profile
- /console/settings/personalization — Models, tone, instructions, memories
- /console/settings/usage — Credits, limits and usage
- /console/settings/data — Import, export, retention
- /console/settings/security — Password, two-factor, sessions, sign-in providers
- /console/settings/notifications — Notification preferences
- /console/settings/api — API keys
